sentences.en: I like tea, but I like coffee more.
sentences.et: Mulle meeldib tee, aga kohv meeldib rohkem.

sentences.en: It is cold, but the sun is shining.
He is tired, yet he is working.
sentences.et: Ta on väsinud, kuid ta töötab.
sentences.notes: "kuid" is a more formal/written synonym of "aga".

sentences.en: I studied a lot, therefore I passed the exam.
sentences.et: Ma õppisin palju, seega ma sooritasin eksami.

sentences.en: Although it is raining, I am going outside.
sentences.et: Kuigi sajab vihma, ma lähen välja.

sentences.en: I like him, although he is sometimes strange.
sentences.et: Mulle meeldib tema, kuigi ta on vahel imelik.

sentences.en: First I eat, and then I work.
sentences.et: Kõigepealt ma söön ja siis ma töötan.

sentences.en: I want to travel, but I don't have money.
sentences.et: Ma tahan reisida, aga mul ei ole raha.

sentences.en: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
